items.title: Extend scope_check_save schema with a required signed readManifest field
items.context: Shape: {filesReadFully[], filesTriagedByName[], scanEscalationReason|null}. Validate the shape, include readManifest in the scope-check signature domain (_hash), and reject saves that omit it. Keep the existing anti-self-absolution boundaries (resolutions/OQ stay outside the signature domain) unchanged.
items.userSees: Missing readManifest in scope_check_save is rejected with a clear validation error; valid scope-check evidence shows a signed readManifest field.

happy.desc: A valid scope_check_save payload with filesReadFully, filesTriagedByName, and scanEscalationReason persists normalized readManifest and includes it in the signed scope-check hash.

edge.desc: Empty arrays, triaged-only reads, null scanEscalationReason, and sorted duplicate-free paths normalize deterministically without changing existing OQ/resolution exclusions.

adversarial.desc: Missing, malformed, duplicate, unsafe, or post-hoc edited readManifest fails closed and hash verification changes when only readManifest changes.

items.title: Extend review_pass_set schema with the same required readManifest field
items.context: Same shape and signing treatment as scope-check so REVIEW-phase passes carry read evidence; the ledger must expose the field so runs can be compared over time (trend queries).
items.userSees: Missing readManifest in review_pass_set is rejected; valid review pass evidence displays an inspectable signed readManifest field.

happy.desc: A valid review_pass_set payload persists normalized readManifest and includes it in the review pass integrity/signature domain.

edge.desc: Review passes with triaged-only files, null scanEscalationReason, and deterministic path ordering remain comparable with scope_check_save readManifest records.

adversarial.desc: Missing, malformed, duplicate, unsafe, or tampered readManifest on review_pass_set fails closed and cannot be silently accepted as reviewer prose.

items.title: Update reviewer templates and dispatch prompts to submit readManifest
items.context: scope-plan and REVIEW-phase reviewer templates must instruct submitting the structured field (B-cee5 bounded-contract language already exists in the templates); a missing submission must surface as a gate rejection, not a silent pass.

items.title: M2: derive a mechanical per-run read log for decisions/*.md
items.context: Either retain the reviewer's stream-json transcript at dispatch and extract the Read-call list (productize the fa1777b analyze_arm.py approach), or add a PreToolUse Read hook following the .claude/hooks/lattice-scope-pretool.cjs pattern; bind the read-log digest as run evidence.

items.title: M2: flag self-report vs mechanical-log mismatch and unrecorded full scans
items.context: A full-content directory read of docs/requirements/decisions/ without a recorded scanEscalationReason is the defined failure signal; a mismatch between readManifest and the mechanical read log files a finding. Recording only — do not block or alter the escalation path itself, and do not make memory/playbook output gate evidence.

items.title: Guard smoke coverage for the readManifest gate and mismatch detector
items.context: Extend packages/main/src/tasks/reviewer-scan-budget-guard-smoke.ts (from B-cee5) so validate catches regressions: missing readManifest passing a save, and mismatch/unrecorded-full-scan cases going unflagged. Align with the B-04bb validate wiring follow-up.
